title: A one-column table constructor mixing a number, a date, a Boolean and text gives a column of strings

source.quote: Returns the following table of a single column of String data type:
source.supports: the page shows this query and the values 1, 1/1/2017, TRUE, A

source.quote: When the data types of the values for a column are different in different rows, all values are converted to a common data type.

notes: The strings are spelled as the page prints them. How the date and the Boolean are written as text (1/1/2017, TRUE) depends on the engine and on the en-US culture; the page may have printed them loosely.
